avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces regorafenib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discontinue at least 2 weeks before regorafenib initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (Panax)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may decrease regorafenib exposure and effectiveness
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer reduces TKI concentration
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue before treatment; allow 2-week washout period

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin (Turmeric)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4 and increase regorafenib levels; also has anticoagulant properties
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; use moderate amounts and report bleeding symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase regorafenib exposure and toxicity
caution_supplements.action: Limit consumption; maintain consistent intake if used

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids (Fish Oil)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive anticoagulant/antiplatelet effects increasing bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for bleeding; coordinate dosing with healthcare provider

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increases regorafenib plasma concentration and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and juice; substitute other citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Regorafenib absorption increased with food; high-fat meals may increase variability in plasma levels
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; if taking with food, maintain consistent fat intake

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous Vegetables (Broccoli, Cabbage, Brussels Sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 inducers that may modestly reduce regorafenib exposure with excessive intake
caution_foods.action: Normal dietary consumption acceptable; excessive supplementation should be avoided

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase hepatotoxicity risk and gastrointestinal side effects; impairs drug metabolism
caution_foods.action: Minimize alcohol consumption; report any liver function changes

monitoring_notes: Monitor liver function tests, blood pressure, and signs of bleeding given regorafenib's hepatotoxicity and hemorrhage risks. Counsel patients on strict avoidance of CYP3A4 inducers and grapefruit to maintain therapeutic drug levels; consistent food intake timing is recommended.
